sections.label: Criminal justice law amendments
sections.summary: The Criminal Procedure Code and Evidence Act were amended in 2018, and the Penal Code is under review with recommendations due later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: To ensure just outcomes and fair procedures in the criminal justice system, we amended the Criminal Procedure Code and the Evidence Act in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We are reviewing the Penal Code together with the Ministry of Home Affairs, and the review committee will make its recommendations later this year.

sections.label: Family Justice Review Committee
sections.summary: MinLaw, the Ministry of Social and Family Development and the Courts established the Family Justice Review Committee to enhance the family justice system and centre it on child and family welfare.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Together with the Ministry of Social and Family Development and the Courts, MinLaw has established the Family Justice Review Committee to enhance the family justice system, by reducing acrimony and stress in family-related litigation, to ensure a system that centres on the welfare of the child and the family.

sections.label: Tribunals and SCT claims limits
sections.summary: The Community Disputes Resolution Tribunals and Small Claims Tribunals offer cost-effective dispute resolution, and the SCT claims limits are being reviewed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The Community Disputes Resolution Tribunals and the Small Claims Tribunals (SCT) provide cost-effective avenues for our people and businesses to resolve disputes without the need for legal representation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We are reviewing the claims limits for the SCT to allow more to benefit from this quick and inexpensive forum.

sections.label: Tech Start for Law programme
sections.summary: The Tech Start for Law programme was launched in 2017 with the Law Society and SPRING, and its next phase is being developed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We are also helping them to prepare for the future economy through the adoption of technology, internationalisation and capability-building.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We launched the Tech Start for Law programme in 2017 with the Law Society and the then-Standards, Productivity and Innovation Board (SPRING), and will be developing the next phase of this programme to meet the needs of our law firms.

sections.label: International legal negotiations role
sections.summary: Singapore plays a leading role in negotiations on dispute settlement, international cooperation against crime, and recognition and enforcement of judgments, and serves as a neutral venue for state-related disputes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We play a leading role in key negotiations, such as dispute settlement, international cooperation to combat crime, and the recognition and enforcement of judgments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We do our part for the international community by serving as a neutral venue for state-related disputes, enabled through partnerships with the Permanent Court of Arbitration, among others.

sections.label: SLA land and geospatial technology
sections.summary: SLA is leveraging data and technology for land administration, leading geospatial capability building with the Government Technology Agency, and will release the Singapore Geospatial Master Plan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The Singapore Land Authority (SLA) is also actively leveraging data and technology, including the development of a paperless Land Titles Registry system and the use of drones, to support land administration and management.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: SLA has been leading Singapore’s efforts in building geospatial capabilities together with the Government Technology Agency.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: It has launched GeoWorks, which facilitates the co-creation of business opportunities with startups and industry partners.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: SLA will be releasing the Singapore Geospatial Master Plan that will set out the strategic initiatives to strengthen Singapore's geospatial capabilities.
